rows.source: It's a page from someone's diary...^^...There are only a few 'older' bachelors in town, and none of them are perfect! Harvey is really anxious and weak, but I know he would make a loyal and devoted husband. He likes coffee and pickles.^^Elliott is a bit foppish and melodramatic, but he does have a nice chin. He likes crab cakes and pomegranates.^^Shane is messy and anti-social. But I think his gruff exterior is a defense mechanism, insulating his softness from the world. He likes Beer, Pizza, and Pepper Poppers.%revealtaste:Harvey:395%revealtaste:Harvey:342%revealtaste:Elliott:732%revealtaste:Elliott:637%revealtaste:Shane:346%revealtaste:Shane:206%revealtaste:Shane:215
rows.translation: Je to stránka z něčího deníku...^^...Ve městě je jen pár „starších“ svobodných mužů a ani jeden není dokonalý! Harvey je opravdu úzkostlivý a slabý, ale vím, že by byl věrným a oddaným manželem. Má rád kávu a nakládanou zeleninu.^^Elliott je trochu fintivý a melodramatický, ale má pěknou bradu. Má rád krabí koláčky a granátová jablka.^^Shane je nepořádný a nespolečenský. Myslím si ale, že jeho drsný zevnějšek je obranný mechanismus, který chrání jeho citlivé nitro před světem. Má rád pivo, pizzu a paprikové jednohubky.%revealtaste:Harvey:395%revealtaste:Harvey:342%revealtaste:Elliott:732%revealtaste:Elliott:637%revealtaste:Shane:346%revealtaste:Shane:206%revealtaste:Shane:215

rows.source: I've found some good things by looking in the garbage cans, on lucky days.^^Sometimes you'll find the 'dish of the day' behind the saloon... usually fresh!^^For dessert, I'll check the Mullners' can for cookies.^^For treasures, check the cans by the blacksmith and museum.
